objective: Close predicted-control metric gaps through architecture audits and targeted repairs, then complete matched multi-seed residential, RPLAN, and editing evidence needed for a defensible CVPR submission. Do not write the paper.

policy.experiment_rule: Use logs, tensor contracts, gradient reach, parameter ownership, and consumer audits to identify a defect before paying for another GPU screen.
policy.small_subset_rule: Mechanism screens use train64/val32 seed19 and are candidates, never paper results.
policy.promotion_rule: Only full-data, multi-seed, matched, frozen-evaluator results can support SOTA or significance claims.

evidence_ledgers.rule: Completed task bodies are removed from this file; durable outcomes and lessons remain in these ledgers.

diagnostics.interpretation: Room foreground support is much stronger than room identity, count, and semantic assignment. Node quality exceeds edge quality, so graph endpoint identity is not the only blocker.

room_query_decoder.area_regression: matched area was diagnostic-only before v342

room_graph.class_residual: zero-sum across active queries in area-preserving mode
room_graph.last_bundle_screen: rejected: relational+prior+second graph increased GED and reduced Instance F1

objective_binding.query_separation: implemented but rejected as a standalone quality lever

zero_path_status.remaining_zero_tensors: standard zero biases, zero residual parameters, or disabled optional branches; no known enabled upstream trunk is blocked
zero_path_status.requirement: Every new optional module needs first-step gradient and output-consumer tests before a screen.

claim_boundaries.oracle_control: Strong consistency evidence is valid only under the stated oracle-control protocol.
claim_boundaries.predicted_control: No predicted-control SOTA claim while any absolute gate above is unmet.
claim_boundaries.house_mind: No complete-method defeat claim without executable matched inference.
claim_boundaries.ce2eplan: Generation-only anchor; never present it as an editing baseline.
claim_boundaries.raster2seq: Matched reconstruction anchor only; never rank different evaluation splits as identity editing.
claim_boundaries.watertight_guard: Report repair and introduced failures separately; do not claim a net gain without matched evidence.

tasks.title: Turn query ownership from a weak soft blend into a reliable identity mechanism

tasks.critical_repair: The selected-query class gather expanded its class index to one, so owner-preserving logits were truncated to class zero and broadcast as a class-constant map. The gather now retains the complete room-class distribution.
tasks.relative_candidate: owner_preserving_room_readout accepts historical true/false values and a new relative mode. Relative mode uses query ownership mass rather than absolute mask sigmoid, and is isolated in configs/predicted_channel_v6_owner_relative_only.json.
tasks.runtime_evidence: cuda:0 live contract passes on a real checkpoint with all owner class channels live, full room shape [1,24,128,128], finite outputs, and config-matched four-stage refresh. On this case absolute owner soft weight is 0.0246, relative ownership mean is 0.3956, and strict absolute owner foreground is only 0.0070. Source: outputs/reports/owner_class_consumer_live_contract_cuda0_v1.json.
tasks.relative_zero_shot: Same checkpoint on 32 matched cases: relative owner raises foreground 0.02616 to 0.25094, Room IoU +0.000318 with crossing CI, Instance F1 -0.017020, count MAE +1.46875, Wall F1 -0.003601 with CI excluding zero, and GED +0.15625. Rejected as a drop-in inference replacement. Source: outputs/reports/owner_same_weight_val32_seed19_compare_v1.json.
tasks.contract_evidence: 1249 passed, 1 skipped on the complete non-chip/non-NLP suite; touched-file Ruff and the 599-line guard pass.
tasks.implemented_diagnostics: Validation now logs owner soft weight, relative query ownership, foreground fraction, and total gated query mass without changing readout behavior.
next: Keep the corrected absolute owner readout as the current inference contract.
Only train the relative owner candidate if its model-side calibration objective changes, not merely its inference gate.
Track owner specificity and fallback fraction on every validation case.
Verify query embeddings, adaptive references, owner logits, and class evidence receive non-zero gradients from the full objective.
tasks.pass_gate: Owner specialization rises while background/footprint precision and semantic room IoU do not regress.

tasks.title: Close the Node-to-Edge/GED gap without perturbing room scale
tasks.known_issue: Node F1 0.727429 but Edge overlap 0.361825; 75 cases have Node F1 >= 0.8 with Edge < 0.5.
tasks.same_weight_result: Area-preserving graph residual is not a valid drop-in replacement: Instance F1, count, Wall, Edge, and GED regress significantly. Preserving area is necessary but insufficient for correct owner reassignment.
tasks.owner_swap: A real cuda:0 case changes owner on 56.98% of supported pixels, with support covering 28.22% of the image. Diagnostics now log owner-swap fraction and support for both graph passes.
tasks.inference_mode_matrix: Same-weight constraining does not help: area-preserving, owner-margin, class-only, and full bypass all regress Instance/count/Wall. Full bypass changes Instance F1 -0.026571, count MAE +1.78125, and Wall F1 -0.005914, so the current free graph has positive contribution and remains the control.
next: Keep the current free graph for inference; train any safe graph mode from the matched control.
Bound adjacent-query owner swaps and test preservation of per-query mask mass.
Verify graph class residual does not damage type identity in non-area-preserving controls.
Audit mask-contact tolerance against the canonical type-edge evaluator.
Use the isolated source-router/room-graph arms before composing another bundle.
tasks.pass_gate: Edge overlap >= 0.50 and GED <= 6.0 with Node F1 non-regression.

global_stop_rules: Do not promote an arm when its cheap proxy improves while the canonical consumer regresses.
Do not add capacity before the corresponding output has a live consumer and first-step gradient.
Do not stack independent frontier arms without a matched composition screen.
Do not open test503 or the RPLAN test split for mechanism selection.
Do not claim SOTA from oracle controls, small subsets, single seeds, or relative-only gains.
Do not modify chips, FloorSet, or NLP files.
